archimate:DataObject.name: Canonical Payload Schema
archimate:DataObject.documentation:
The logical data architecture defines the structures, contract formats, payload limits, and governance metadata required to standardize payloads moving across Homes England.
Enterprise Metadata Standards & Schema Governance
To satisfy GOV.UK compliance and ensure data assets remain findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable (FAIR), all message payloads passing through the integration layer must be UTF-8 encoded and carry a mandatory standardized header envelope
